intro: IMLEX Consortium (University of Eastern Finland) is offering a master's opportunity centred on IMLEX – Master of Science in Imaging and Light in Extended Reality (Erasmus Mundus). This is a fully funded opportunity; financial support is listed as €1,400/month (EMJM scholarship rate). The stated deadline is 13 January 2027.

seoDescription: IMLEX Erasmus Mundus master in imaging and light for extended reality (Finland-Japan). Applications 2 Dec 2026 - 13 Jan 2027 (23:59 UTC+2). Full scholarships.
description:
About the Scholarship

IMLEX combines photonics, lighting technology and computer science for extended-reality applications, coordinated from the University of Eastern Finland with Japanese industry ties through Yoshino Co. The next application round runs from 2 December 2026 to 13 January 2027 (23:59 UTC+2) via the national Studyinfo service.

OpportunityIMLEX – Master of Science in Imaging and Light in Extended Reality (Erasmus Mundus)
HostIMLEX Consortium (University of Eastern Finland)
LocationJoensuu (multi-country mobility), Finland
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendFull Erasmus Mundus scholarships for the best applicants:
Application Deadline13 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

IMLEX combines photonics, lighting technology and computer science for extended-reality applications, coordinated from the University of Eastern Finland with Japanese industry ties through Yoshino Co. The next application round runs from 2 December 2026 to 13 January 2027 (23:59 UTC+2) via the national Studyinfo service.

Programme Highlights

  • XR-plus-photonics specialisation with a Japanese industrial partner
  • Six-week application window: 2 December 2026 – 13 January 2027
  • Full Erasmus Mundus scholarships for the best-ranked applicants
  • Graduates work in AR/VR engineering, lighting design and imaging systems

Who Should Apply

Physics, photonics, computer science and electrical engineering graduates with programming basics fit the curriculum; the Studyinfo form carries the standard document set.

Funding and Costs

Full Erasmus Mundus scholarships for the best applicants: tuition coverage plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through Studyinfo when the round opens on 2 December 2026 and submit before 13 January 2027 (23:59 UTC+2). Key deadline information: 13 January 2027 (23:59 UTC+2); application window 2 December 2026 – 13 January 2027 via Studyinfo.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About IMLEX Consortium (University of Eastern Finland)

The IMLEX consortium is coordinated by the University of Eastern Finland and delivers the Erasmus Mundus master in Imaging and Light in Extended Reality with European and Japanese partners.

Official website: https://www.imlex.org

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 13 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
